<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/sites/{siteCode}/structures"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Adds a site-scoped physical obstacle — a wall, column, office, conveyor, or other fixed object — to the warehouse map (ADR-0017). A FixedStructure is not a location: nothing can be stowed at it. The site must already exist. Publishes FixedStructureRegistered.
